about: The mouth corpus's regression slice (backend/test_mouth_corpus.py). Sounds from espeak-ng with kokoro-en-v0_19's espeak-ng-data (as sherpa-onnx makes them); lengths (Kokoro frames of 25 ms per sound, per piece) from model.durations.onnx in the four voices; the 720 Harvard sentences are IEEE 1969, public domain.
